integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic \(\mathbb C^*\)-actions, and projectivity identifies compactly supported and ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0403132 gives the first submission date 2004-03-08.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A diagonal one-parameter subgroup with base-\(B\) variable weights, \(B>d\), separates all degree-\(d\) monomials.
integrity.membership_basis: For \(k<d\), a monomial lies in \(O_{k,n,d}\) exactly when it is divisible by \(x_i^{d-k}\) for some coordinate variable, by unique factorization.
integrity.object_basis: The archival full text defines the k-th osculating variety and states \(O_{k,n,d}=\{[L^{d-k}F]\}\).

scientific_limitations: The result computes only ordinary Euler characteristic, not Betti numbers, mixed Hodge structure, singularities, degree, equations, or higher-secant defectivity.
The theorem concerns the osculating variety itself and not its higher secant varieties.
The proof is short once the monomial fixed-point classification is noticed, so an older unindexed or folklore observation may exist.
title: Euler characteristic of every Veronese osculating variety
